children: The yen is vulnerable to sharp swings and further declines over the next week as Japan enters a three-day holiday that is expected to thin trading liquidity, according to Bloomberg.
Investors were disappointed that the Bank of Japan did not give stronger guidance on the pace of future interest-rate hikes.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Yen Faces More Volatility After BOJ Disappoints
